# Solana Pyth API

> Explore Solana Pyth API price feeds with the Vybe Solana API: live USD prices, OHLC candles, historical price series, product metadata and oracle tools.

Live demo of the Vybe Solana API. The linked docs pages are the Markdown versions.

## Demo
- [Solana Pyth API](https://solana-pyth-api.vybenetwork.com/): Explore Solana Pyth API price feeds with the Vybe Solana API: live USD prices, OHLC candles, historical price series, product metadata and oracle tools.

## Docs

- [Pyth Price Candles](https://docs.vybenetwork.com/reference/get_pyth_price_ohlc_v4.md)
- [Pyth Price History](https://docs.vybenetwork.com/reference/get_pyth_price_ts_v4.md)
- [Pyth Product](https://docs.vybenetwork.com/reference/get_pyth_product_v4.md)
